about: suite size budgets (design 5 item 11), gzip level 9 bytes unless stated. first-load is the entry html plus every js and css it loads before any route chunk; tool-chunk is any lazy js chunk, model runtimes and wasm cores excluded because they never enter the bundle; single is the raw size of the full single file html the smokes run on; group-raw is the raw size of each group single file in dist/groups, 8 MB each by design 5 item 11. Check with node tools/check-size.mjs after a build.
